journeys.title: Which total function achieves both bounds?
journeys.scope: The classical theorem accepts an arbitrary partial function. The quantum proof already specializes its decoder to Forrelation. At fixed k, the exact circuit determines the input type of the board used by both bounds.

steps.site: addressedF (P k t) C (2 * t) (40 * t)

steps.site: fun h => decode_samples hk (instLoc i h) n

    (budget_le ht (forrCircuit_size_le l t ht))

    fun h8 hLR => Gvalue_lt_R_Fkm hk h8 _ (forrCircuit_realises l t) hLR⟩

steps.title: Supply the eventual hardness threshold at the same fixed order
steps.site:
obtain ⟨S, A, b, hA, hfam⟩ := family_bounds k hk
  obtain ⟨t₀, ht₀⟩ := ForrelationLower.bansalSinhaLower k hk
  refine ⟨S, A, b, max t₀ 8, hA, fun t ht => ?_⟩
  have h1 : 1 ≤ t := le_trans (le_max_left _ _) ht
  have h2 : max t₀ 8 ≤ t := le_trans (le_max_right _ _) ht
  obtain ⟨C, hC, hS, hQ, hR⟩ := hfam t h1
  exact ⟨C, hC, hS, hQ, hR (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) h2)
    (ht₀ t (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) h2))⟩

steps.title: After fixing α below four, choose k with α/2 < 2 − 1/k
steps.site:
obtain ⟨k, hk, hs⟩ := exists_nat_exponent hα
  exact not_universalPower_of_familyBoundsAt hRreindex hQreindex (hfam k hk) hs

steps.title: For any proposed constant D take t beyond both thresholds
steps.site:
obtain ⟨T, hT⟩ := exists_threshold_gap b hc hC hD hα hs
  obtain ⟨Cir, -, hQle, hRge⟩ := hfam (max T t₀) (le_max_right _ _)
  have hgap := hT _ (le_max_left _ _) _ _ (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hQle hRge
  exact absurd (transport_bound hRreindex hQreindex hbound (Fkm k (max T t₀) Cir)) (not_le.2 hgap)

steps.title: Establish the independent upper bound for every total Boolean function

  obtain ⟨h₁, h₂⟩ := R_le_D_le_one_add_Q_pow_four f

steps.title: Combine exclusion below four with membership at four

    hfam universalPower_four

journeys.title: Why does the prediction bound survive adaptive queries?
journeys.scope: The column and proposed query time are fixed before averaging. Lightness is inside the event under the original product law. The predictor is capped on every branch.

steps.title: Cap the simulator at L target queries
steps.site:
let sim := addressSimulator L t T J A i
  have hsim : sim.capped fun _ => L :=
    OutTree.capped_of_depth_le (addressSimulator_depth_le L t T J A i) fun _ => le_rfl

steps.title: Use whole-run nonheaviness to replay the prefix before the proposed query
steps.site:
have hc : ((T.path x).take t).countP (fun q => (aTarget i q).isSome) ≤ L :=
            ((List.take_sublist t _).countP_le).trans (not_lt.mp hnh)
          have hs : sim.eval (Function.uncurry U) = trueAddr f U :=
            eval_simTree x (Function.uncurry U) (fun _ hq' => dummy_update_of_aTarget_none hq')
              (fun _ _ hq' => dummy_update_of_aTarget_some hq') T t L hq
              (cellGuess_of_cellOf hcell) hc

steps.title: Resample the target column from its original law and apply the independent prediction bound
steps.site:
rw [avg_resample (sum_prodW hμ1) i]
  refine avg_le_const (prodW_nonneg (prodW_nonneg hμ))
    (sum_prodW (sum_prodW hμ1)) fun A => ?_
  exact avg_reachedCellAt_le hμ hdom (fun U hU => address_guess_le hμ hard U hU) T J A i t

journeys.title: Where does the Gaussian derivative identity enter the proof?
journeys.scope: These applications locate individual steps in the formal implementation. The correspondence of the entire printed derivative transport requires a separate review.

steps.title: Apply the Gaussian identity to the decision-tree observable
steps.site:
set g : (BC l n → Bool) → ℝ := fun z => v (T.eval z) with hg
  obtain ⟨s, hs, hid⟩ := exists_identity H hl g
  rw [integral_ext_wv_zero H hH g] at hid

steps.title: Control derivative growth along distinct paths
steps.site:
have hgrow := sum_abs_ext_Dl_le (Lpath l) Lpath_nodup (k := l + 1)
      (fun p => by simp [Lpath, plist_length]) Lpath_inj hμ hd hK hKsq hn T hT v hv

steps.title: Specialize the matrix to the normalized Hadamard matrix
steps.site:
have := advantage_le_sharp (H t) hl (rowsOrth_H t) (ε := ((2 : ℝ) ^ t)⁻¹) (by positivity) abs_H_le
      (d := 2 * τ * L + 1) (Nat.succ_pos _) hK hKsq hcard (T j) ((hdepth j).trans (Nat.le_succ _))
      v hv

steps.title: Apply the same identity to the Forrelation polynomial for the promise estimate
steps.site:

  rw [integral_ext_wv_zero (H t) (rowsOrth_H t)] at hid
